title: llama.cpp
description: OpenAI-compatible GGUF inference on llama.cpp. Loads models from Runpod's model cache with no download at cold start, supports vision projectors, and pins a known llama.cpp build so model architecture support is explicit.

input.name: Cached model repository
input.description: Hugging Face repo holding the GGUF, e.g. Abiray/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M-GGUF. Set the endpoint's Model field to the same value so Runpod caches it before the worker starts. Prefer single-quant repos: caching mirrors the whole repo.

input.name: GGUF filename
input.description: Name of the .gguf inside the cached repository, e.g. Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf. Required when using a cached model repository.

input.name: Vision projector filename
input.description: Optional multimodal projector inside the same cached repository, e.g. mmproj-F16.gguf. Leave empty for text-only models.

input.name: llama-server arguments
input.description: Passed through to llama-server. The model, projector, host and port are set by the worker and are rejected here. Note that --batch-size 2048, --ubatch-size 512, --jinja and --no-context-shift are already upstream defaults.

input.name: Download model at startup
input.description: Alternative to the cache: a llama.cpp -hf spec such as unsloth/gemma-3-270m-it-GGUF:Q6_K, downloaded on every cold start. Convenient for trials, slow and billed for large models. Mutually exclusive with the cached repository and model path.

input.name: Model path on disk
input.description: Absolute path to a .gguf already on disk, typically on a network volume. Mutually exclusive with the other two sources.

input.name: Vision projector path on disk
input.description: Absolute path to a projector file, used with the model path above.

input.name: Startup timeout (seconds)
input.description: How long to wait for llama-server to report healthy. Large models load slowly; a 17 GB model needs several minutes.

input.name: Concurrent requests per worker
input.description: Keep at 1 unless --parallel is raised in the arguments above. llama.cpp divides the context across parallel slots.

input.name: Reported model id
input.description: Overrides the model name echoed in responses. Defaults to whatever llama-server reports.

input.name: Model cache directory
input.description: Where Runpod places cached Hugging Face snapshots. Only change this if Runpod moves the cache.
